message.content:
Surgical fix for 2 sections in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq.

PART A — PORTFOLIO CAROUSEL (drift +74-124px across viewports)

ROOT CAUSE: Webflow base CSS has `.image-cover { max-height: 357px }` as a hard cap. An earlier audit-pass cleanup removed this clamp. Restore.

File `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/home/portfolio-carousel.module.css`:
- Find the base `.image-cover` rule (around line 130 area, declares `object-fit`, `object-position`, `border-radius`, `width`, `height: auto`).
- ADD `max-height: 357px;` to the base `.image-cover` rule.
- Verify min-width 1280 + min-width 1440 overrides on `.image-cover.radius-0` are intact (they set explicit height 360px @1280 and 410px @1440 — KEEP these).
- Verify max-width 991/767/479 don't conflict — if any have explicit `height` for `.image-cover` that's smaller than 357, leave them alone.

PART B — HERO (persistent +33 desktop / +87 mobile)

ROOT CAUSE: 
- Mobile +87 likely from button stacking + `.code-embed-3` margins + `.div-job-attention.mob-margin-less` margin.
- Desktop +33 likely from `.code-embed-3 { margin-bottom: 80px }` vs Webflow value.

File `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/home/hero.module.css`:

1. Audit `.code-embed-3` against Webflow CSS:
   ```
   grep -nB 1 -A 8 '^\\.code-embed-3' boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css
   ```
   Apply Webflow's exact `margin-top` and `margin-bottom` values.

2. Audit `.margin-top-50` (the GuideJar wrapper class):
   ```
   grep -nB 1 -A 8 '^\\.margin-top-50' boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css
   ```
   Apply exact margin/padding values at base + every breakpoint.

3. Audit `.div-job-attention.mob-margin-less`:
   ```
   grep -nB 1 -A 8 'div-job-attention.mob-margin-less\\|^\\.mob-margin-less' boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css
   ```
   Apply exact margin-top values per breakpoint.

4. Audit `.a-gulf-book` and `.a-except-get` font-size + padding at @max-width:479:
   ```
   grep -nB 1 -A 12 '^\\.a-gulf-book\\|^\\.a-except-get' boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css | head -200
   ```
   Match Webflow values for mobile (font-size, padding, line-height).

5. Verify `.section-high-judge` padding at @max-width:479 is `padding-top: 3rem; padding-bottom: 2.5rem` (already in module CSS).

CONSTRAINTS:
- NO compensation hacks. Match Webflow values verbatim.
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- Don't touch other files
- Don't add deps
- Don't run tests yourself

After both edits run `pnpm build` to verify 0 errors.

OUTPUT: 1-line summary per file edit + build result.
